title: Watering can with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M22 55 L8 38 L13 33 L26 48 Z' fill='#5BC8F5' stroke='#8AE0FF' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- spout end cap -->
  <ellipse cx='10' cy='34' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8AE0FF' transform='rotate(-40 10 34)'/>
  <!-- spout holes -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='31' r='1.2' fill='#C8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#C8F0FF'/>
  <circle cx='9' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#C8F0FF'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='22' y='42' width='52' height='40' rx='8' fill='#4AB8E8'/>
  <!-- body highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='26' y='46' width='44' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#7AD4F0'/>
  <!-- body lower shade -->
  <rect x='22' y='74' width='52' height='8' rx='4' fill='#3A9CC8'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M74 52 Q92 52 92 68 Q92 78 74 78' fill='none' stroke='#5BC8F5' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle highlight -->
  <path d='M74 52 Q92 52 92 68 Q92 78 74 78' fill='none' stroke='#8AE0FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top rim -->
  <rect x='30' y='38' width='36' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7AD4F0'/>
  <!-- face area -->
  <rect x='30' y='54' width='36' height='22' rx='6' fill='#2E8CB8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='64' r='1.6' fill='#1A5270'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='64' r='1.6' fill='#1A5270'/>
  <!-- eye sparkle -->
  <circle cx='41.8' cy='62.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='53.8' cy='62.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 69 Q46 76 54 69' fill='none' stroke='#FFF9C4' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#FF9EB5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#FF9EB5' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- small water drops from spout -->
  <ellipse cx='5' cy='28' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#9EE8FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='13' cy='27' rx='1' ry='2' fill='#9EE8FF'/>
  <ellipse cx='8' cy='24' rx='1' ry='1.8' fill='#C8F0FF'/>
</svg>
